howToUse.title: How to use Open in Nusuk
howToUse.step1: Open the Nusuk app on your phone and stay on the Home page.
howToUse.step2: Come back here and tap Open in Nusuk. It opens the Nusuk service page with the code already filled in.
howToUse.step3: In Nusuk, go to the Keys tab and paste the code into the 'Add code' box, then tap Check the code.
howToUse.step4: When the Congratulations screen appears, stay on it — do not tap back or close the app.
howToUse.step5: Return here and tap Open in Nusuk on the next code. Repeat for every extra key you want.
howToUse.footnote: Tip: Copy the code first as a backup if the deep link opens the wrong screen.

seoText.title: How to use these free Nusuk referral codes
seoText.p1: Every code on this page is a real Nusuk referral invite [Share code] entered by someone else taking part in the Free Umrah Competition. Tap Open in Nusuk and the code is filled in for you, or copy it, open the Nusuk app, go to the Keys tab or the challenge, and paste it. You and the person who shared both get one extra key. Which means one more question and one more entry in the daily Umrah draw.
seoText.p2: Fresh codes are added all day and every code gets a fair turn, so no one hacks daily. Codes that do not work regular reports and removed, so replied listeners can count on fresh codes always.
